Definition: altitude, i.e. concretely (an elevated place), abstractly (elevation, figuratively (elation), or adverbially (aloft)
BiblicalUsage: 1) height; 1a) height, elevation, elevated place; 1a1) in a high place (adv); 1b) height; 1c) proudly (adv); 1d) of nobles (fig.)
